name: Wind Voice Full Throttle
original_name: ウィンドヴォイス フルスロットル
source: Omega, a demon protagonist who lived happily surrounded by mathematical formulas on Earth. One day, he was suddenly asked by his brother Root, the King of Heaven, to become the guardian and tutor for one of his two nephews. Will Omega be able to safely return to his former life?
